name: Positran Manufacturing Inc
old_description: Positran Manufacturing Inc. is a Full-Service Electronic Contract Manufacturing Firm which operates in a 45,000 square foot state-of-the-art manufacturing facility. We are proud to be your one stop source for all of your manufacturing requirements. Our full service offering includes PCB design/layout, PCBA assembly, Cable/Harness assembly, Electro-Mechanical assembly, Full Product Assembly, Functional and In-Circuit testing, packaging, warehousing and distribution. PMI is your dedicated business partner. All of our products are manufactured utilizing modern, high quality equipment, and in accordance with IPC-610 guidelines under a strict quality management system. Our professional staff will keep you updated on all facets of your manufacturing project making sure it is delivered to you on-time and under budget each and every time. We are committed to the success of your product because –
